sections.heading: A school that blends academics, values and modern skills
sections.text: FUTURE SPARK INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL A school that blends academics, values and modern skills Located at Kavuri Hills, Hyderabad — we focus on discipline, academic brilliance and all-round excellence through sports and co-curricular activities. Smart Classrooms Technology-enabled learning with digital boards and modern teaching. Safety First Secure campus with CC cameras, medical assistance and support staff. Holistic Development Sports, arts, clubs and activities that build confidence and character.

sections.heading: Future Spark International School
sections.text: ABOUT THE SCHOOL Future Spark International School Welcome to Future Spark International School. Future Spark School is located in the serene residential area at Kavuri Hills, Hyderabad, the modern metropolitan city. The school is a co-educational institution pursuing academic brilliance and all round excellence. The school stands for discipline, honing the skills involved in academics, sports and co curricular activities. Future Spark's aim is to build citizens that India will be proud of. Read More Contact Us
